name: Truck Off
summary: A Buy Now button that folds into a truck, loads parcels and drives off the screen
about: A product card whose Buy Now button turns into a small delivery truck. The button squashes and folds into a cargo box while a cab and wheels spring out one by one, three parcels drop in as a meter fills, then the engine rumbles and the truck drives off the screen over a moving road. An order confirmation with confetti takes its place.
how: Pick a shoe size and press Buy Now
The button squashes, shrinks into a cargo box and a cab and wheels spring out
Three parcels drop into the cargo while a loading meter fills
The engine rumbles with smoke and a headlight, the truck revs back
It drives off the screen over moving road lines
An order number, delivery estimate and confetti appear
Press Buy again, or wait, and the truck drives back in and unfolds into a button
